name: Paperspace Core - H100
price_basis: per H100 instance-hour, on-demand, including 12 vCPU + 90 GB RAM. Fetched 2026-10-04. The H100 variant (SXM vs PCIe) is not specified on the pricing page.
notes: Paperspace H100 at $3.09/hr is the second-cheapest published managed-provider H100 rate, 22% below Together AI's on-demand ($3.99), 51% below CoreWeave ($6.16), and 55% below AWS p5 ($6.88). The rate includes 12 vCPU and 90GB RAM. The H100 variant (SXM vs PCIe) is not specified. Paperspace enforces auto-shutdown. Paperspace was acquired by DigitalOcean.
